triples.quote: I mean the ten roubles you borrowed yesterday at about five o’clock on the security of your pistols, from your friend, Pyotr Ilyitch Perhotin.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: I can’t expect you to pat me on the head for what I did to Grigory, for one can’t break old men’s heads with impunity.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: The sale of his watch for six roubles to obtain money for the journey was something new to the lawyers.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: he began, without being particularly urged, to give a minute account of the agonies of jealousy he endured on Grushenka’s account.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: “Write down at once ... at once ... ‘that I snatched up the pestle to go and kill my father ... Fyodor Pavlovitch ... by hitting him on the head with it!’

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: “Well, upon my word, gentlemen! Yes, I took the pestle.... What does one pick things up for at such moments? I don’t know what for. I snatched it up and ran—that’s all.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: “Write down at once ... at once ... ‘that I snatched up the pestle to go and kill my father ... Fyodor Pavlovitch ... by hitting him on the head with it!’

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: “If I didn’t kill Fenya then, gentlemen, it was only because I hadn’t time,” broke from him suddenly at that point in his story.
